---
title: "Analysis of CheckV genomes"
author: "Aydin Karatas"
output: html_document
---


This report describes conservative-trimmed CheckV genomes using the full
bacterial-mode Prokka VFDB set A pool. It retains genome VF presence,
category composition, counts, and annotated maps, and adds balanced genome
downsampling and biological-sample category differential tests.

## Analysis setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Project Coprolite Viromes

BASE.DIR <- "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes/analysis/"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(root.dir = BASE.DIR)

library(tidyverse)
for (helper in c(
  "misc/validate_vf_pool.R",
  "misc/normalize_checkv_lifestyle.R",
  "misc/prepare_checkv_vf_categories.R",
  "misc/prepare_checkv_vf_composition.R",
  "misc/prepare_checkv_vf_summaries.R",
  "misc/prepare_checkv_genome_maps.R",
  "graphing/create_checkv_genome_map.R",
  "stats/downsample_checkv_vf.R",
  "stats/compare_sample_vf_categories.R",
  "graphing/create_vf_composition.R",
  "misc/export_vf_category_analysis.R"
)) source(file.path(BASE.DIR, helper))

  "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes_NOT_CODE/data/20261019"

```

## Input loading and validation

The metadata, features, and VF summaries must have VFDB set A and full-pool
provenance. Genome identities and biological sample identifiers must agree
before any analyses are run. Only conservative trimming is retained.

```{r versioned-complete-CheckV-analysis, results='asis'}
# use regenerated set A tables and validate their provenance.
checkv.input.paths <- file.path(data.dir, c(
  metadata = "checkv_genome_metadata_VFDB_setA.csv",
  features = "checkv_genome_features_VFDB_setA.csv",
  vf.stats = "checkv_genome_vf_stats_VFDB_setA.csv"
))
names(checkv.input.paths) <- c(
  "metadata", "features", "vf.stats"
)
bundle <- list(tag = "VFDB_setA", label = "VFDB set A")
checkv.required.columns <- list(
  metadata = c(
    "checkv_filter", "genome_id", "checkv_contig_id", "category",
    "origin", "sample", "genome_length", "checkv_lifestyle"
  ),
  features = c(
    "checkv_filter", "genome_id", "annotation", "feature_id", "start",
    "end", "strand", "ec_number", "vf_id", "full_seq_evalue",
    "full_seq_score", "full_seq_bias", "vf_description"
  ),
  vf.stats = c(
    "checkv_filter", "genome_id", "checkv_contig_id", "category",
    "origin", "sample", "total_bacterial_orfs", "qualifying_vf_orfs",
    "vf_present",
    "vf_orf_prevalence"
  )
)
analysis.categories <- c("pal", "pre", "ind")
conservative.filter <- "conservative"
checkv.figs.dir <- file.path(figs.dir, "checkv")
dir.create(checkv.figs.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

read.checkv.bundle <- function(bundle) {
  table.paths <- checkv.input.paths
  missing.paths <- table.paths[!file.exists(table.paths)]
  if (length(missing.paths) > 0) {
    stop(
      bundle$label,
      " is missing required files: ",
      paste(missing.paths, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  tables <- lapply(table.paths, read.csv, check.names = TRUE)
  for (table.name in names(tables)) {
    validate.vf.pool(tables[[table.name]], bundle$tag)
    missing.columns <- setdiff(
      checkv.required.columns[[table.name]],
      names(tables[[table.name]])
    )
    if (length(missing.columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        bundle$label,
        " ",
        table.name,
        " table is missing columns: ",
        paste(missing.columns, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }

  for (table.name in c("metadata", "vf.stats")) {
    key <- tables[[table.name]][c("checkv_filter", "genome_id")]
    if (anyDuplicated(key)) {
      stop(bundle$label, " has duplicate CheckV genome keys in ", table.name)
    }
  }
  return(tables)
}

```

```{r read-checkv-inputs}
cat("#### ", bundle$label, "\n\n", sep = "")
checkv.tables <- read.checkv.bundle(bundle)
checkv.tables <- lapply(
  checkv.tables,
  function(table) {
    if ("checkv_filter" %in% names(table)) {
      table <- table %>% filter(checkv_filter == conservative.filter)
    }
    return(table)
  }
)
if (nrow(checkv.tables$metadata) == 0 ||
    nrow(checkv.tables$vf.stats) == 0) {
  stop(bundle$label, " has no conservative-trimmed CheckV genomes")
}

```

```{r prepare-checkv-inputs}
checkv.metadata <- checkv.tables$metadata %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    checkv.lifestyle = checkv_lifestyle,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    genome.length = genome_length
  )
checkv.features <- checkv.tables$features %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    ec.number = ec_number,
    vf.id = vf_id
  )
checkv.vf.stats <- checkv.tables$vf.stats %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    total.bacterial.orfs = total_bacterial_orfs,
    qualifying.vf.orfs = qualifying_vf_orfs,
    vf.orf.prevalence = vf_orf_prevalence
  )

```

```{r validate-checkv-joins}
metadata.keys <- checkv.metadata %>% select(checkv.filter, genome.id)
stats.keys <- checkv.vf.stats %>% select(checkv.filter, genome.id)
if (nrow(anti_join(metadata.keys, stats.keys)) > 0 ||
    nrow(anti_join(stats.keys, metadata.keys)) > 0) {
  stop(bundle$label, " has unmatched metadata and VF-stat genome keys")
}

identity.columns <- c(
  "checkv.filter", "genome.id", "checkv_contig_id", "category", "origin", "sample"
)
if (nrow(anti_join(
  checkv.vf.stats %>% select(all_of(identity.columns)),
  checkv.metadata %>% select(all_of(identity.columns)),
  by = identity.columns
)) > 0) {
  stop(bundle$label, " metadata and VF-stat sample identifiers disagree")
}

vf.plot.data <- checkv.vf.stats %>%
  left_join(
    checkv.metadata %>%
      select(
      checkv.filter,
      genome.id,
      checkv.lifestyle
      ),
    by = c("checkv.filter", "genome.id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(vfdb.version = bundle$label, vfdb.version.tag = bundle$tag)
if (nrow(vf.plot.data) != nrow(checkv.vf.stats) ||
    anyDuplicated(vf.plot.data[c("checkv.filter", "genome.id")])) {
  stop(bundle$label, " VF-stat join duplicated genome rows")
}

```

## Shared VF-category preparation

Both composition versions, downsampling, and sample tests use the same
qualifying ORFs, reference categories, and category colors.

```{r prepare-vf-reference-categories}
# read the same two-header reference format used by the contig report
vf.reference <- read.csv(file.path(data.dir, "VFs.csv"), header = TRUE)
colnames(vf.reference) <- vf.reference[1, ]
vf.reference <- vf.reference[-1, c("VFID", "VFCID", "VF_Name", "VFcategory")]
vf.category.data <- prepare.checkv.vf.categories(checkv.features, vf.reference)
vf.category.colors <- vf.category.data$palette
vf.category.features <- vf.category.data$features
vf.category.tag <- paste0("_", bundle$tag, "_", conservative.filter)

```

## Genome analyses

### Genome VF presence and absence by CheckV lifestyle

Each bar counts all conservative-trimmed genomes in one category and CheckV
lifestyle group. VF-present genomes have at least one qualifying VFDB-hit ORF;
all other genomes are VF-absent. These descriptive genome counts apply no
sample exclusions or ORF cutoff. Unknown lifestyle assignments are
excluded and reported below; `virulent` is normalized to `lytic`. Within each
sample category, All pools the Lytic and Temperate genomes. Blue segments show
VF-present genomes, red segments show VF-absent genomes, and labels give raw
genome counts, including zeros.

```{r genome-VF-presence-absence, results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# count each validated genome once using its CheckV-table lifestyle.
vf.genome.data <- vf.plot.data %>%
  mutate(lifestyle = normalize.checkv.lifestyle(checkv.lifestyle))
vf.genome.excluded <- vf.genome.data %>%
  filter(!lifestyle %in% c("lytic", "temperate")) %>%
  count(category, checkv.lifestyle, name = "excluded.genomes")
cat("\n\nGenomes excluded for unknown CheckV lifestyle: ",
    sum(vf.genome.excluded$excluded.genomes), ".\n\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(vf.genome.excluded) > 0L) {
  print(knitr::kable(vf.genome.excluded))
}
if (any(!vf.genome.data$category %in% analysis.categories)) {
  stop("Genome VF presence/absence has an unexpected category")
}

# complete both statuses; empty bars cannot be interpreted as proportions.
vf.genome.counts <- vf.genome.data %>%
  filter(lifestyle %in% c("lytic", "temperate")) %>%
  { bind_rows(., mutate(., lifestyle = "all")) } %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = analysis.categories),
    lifestyle = factor(
      lifestyle, levels = c("all", "lytic", "temperate"),
      labels = c("All", "Lytic", "Temperate")
    ),
    vf.status = factor(
      if_else(qualifying.vf.orfs > 0L, "present", "absent"),
      levels = c("present", "absent")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(category, lifestyle, vf.status, name = "segment.count") %>%
  complete(category, lifestyle, vf.status, fill = list(segment.count = 0L)) %>%
  arrange(category, lifestyle, vf.status) %>%
  group_by(category, lifestyle) %>%
  mutate(bar.total = sum(segment.count)) %>%
  ungroup()
if (any(vf.genome.counts$bar.total == 0L)) {
  stop("Genome VF presence/absence requires genomes in every lifestyle bar")
}
vf.genome.counts <- vf.genome.counts %>%
  group_by(category, lifestyle) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = segment.count / bar.total,
    segment.top = cumsum(proportion),
    segment.bottom = segment.top - proportion,
    label.y = (segment.bottom + segment.top) / 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    fill.key = factor(
      paste(lifestyle, vf.status),
      levels = c(
        "All present", "All absent",
        "Lytic present", "Lytic absent", "Temperate present",
        "Temperate absent"
      )
    ),
    bar.x = as.numeric(lifestyle),
    count.label = paste0("n = ", format(segment.count, trim = TRUE)),
    label.color = if_else(
      lifestyle %in% c("All", "Lytic") & segment.count > 0L, "white", "black"
    ),
    checkv.filter = conservative.filter,
    vfdb_version = bundle$tag,
    orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds"
  )

# explicit rectangle bounds keep present below absent without stack defaults.
vf.genome.presence.plot <- ggplot(vf.genome.counts) +
  geom_rect(
    data = filter(vf.genome.counts, segment.count > 0L),
    aes(
      xmin = bar.x - 0.36, xmax = bar.x + 0.36,
      ymin = segment.bottom, ymax = segment.top, fill = fill.key
    ),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(vf.genome.counts, segment.count > 0L),
    aes(x = bar.x, y = label.y, label = count.label, color = label.color),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(vf.genome.counts, segment.count == 0L),
    aes(
      x = bar.x, y = segment.bottom, label = count.label,
      vjust = if_else(vf.status == "present", 1.3, -0.3)
    ),
    color = "black", size = 3.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ category, switch = "x", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("All", "Lytic", "Temperate"),
    limits = c(0.5, 3.5), expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(-0.06, 1.06), expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "All present" = "#08306B", "All absent" = "#99000D",
      "Lytic present" = "#3182BD", "Lytic absent" = "#EF3B2C",
      "Temperate present" = "#9ECAE1", "Temperate absent" = "#FCAE91"
    ),
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c("All VF-present", "All VF-absent", "Lytic VF-present",
               "Lytic VF-absent", "Temperate VF-present", "Temperate VF-absent")
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Proportion of genomes", fill = NULL,
    title = "Genome VF presence/absence by CheckV lifestyle",
    subtitle = "VFDB set A; conservative trimming"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) + guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE))

# export the descriptive counts and plot with full-pool provenance.
vf.genome.output.stem <- paste0(
  "vf_genome_presence_absence_by_category_lifestyle_",
  bundle$tag, "_", conservative.filter
)
write.csv(
  vf.genome.counts %>%
    select(
      category, lifestyle, vf.status, segment.count, bar.total, proportion,
      checkv.filter, vfdb_version, orf_pool
    ),
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(vf.genome.output.stem, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
ggsave(
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(vf.genome.output.stem, ".svg")),
  plot = vf.genome.presence.plot, width = 10, height = 7
)
print(vf.genome.presence.plot)
```


### VF-category composition among VF-positive genomes

These bars describe **composition among VF-positive genomes**, rather than
genome prevalence. Every qualifying VF ORF contributes once to its VF category;
each segment is divided by all qualifying VF ORFs in that bar. All pools Lytic
and Temperate genomes, excluding the unknown lifestyles reported above.
The local VF reference supplies category names; unmatched VF IDs remain in the
denominator as **Unmapped VF category** (gray). Reference-category colors are shared across both reports. Groups without VF-positive genomes are explicitly
marked and have zero counts and zero proportions in the exported table.

```{r VF-category-composition, results='asis', fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# retain and export unmatched identifiers across the full conservative pool
vf.category.unmapped <- vf.category.features %>%
  filter(vf.category == "Unmapped VF category") %>%
  group_by(vf.id) %>%
  summarise(qualifying.vf.orfs = n(), genomes = n_distinct(genome.id),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(checkv.filter = conservative.filter, vfdb_version = bundle$tag,
         orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds", vf.reference = "VFs.csv")
write.csv(
  vf.category.unmapped,
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_unmapped_category_ids",
                                  vf.category.tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE
)
cat("\n\nUnmapped VF ORFs in the full conservative pool: ",
    sum(vf.category.unmapped$qualifying.vf.orfs), " of ",
    nrow(vf.category.features), ".\n\n", sep = "")

vf.composition <- prepare.checkv.vf.composition(
  vf.plot.data, vf.category.features,
  category.names = names(vf.category.colors)
) %>%
  mutate(vf.category = factor(vf.category, levels = names(vf.category.colors)),
         checkv.filter = conservative.filter, vfdb_version = bundle$tag,
         orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds", vf.reference = "VFs.csv",
         population = "VF-positive genomes with recognized CheckV lifestyle")
vf.composition.empty <- vf.composition %>%
  distinct(category, lifestyle, vf.positive.genomes) %>%
  filter(vf.positive.genomes == 0L)
vf.composition.plot <- ggplot(
  vf.composition, aes(x = lifestyle, y = proportion, fill = vf.category)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(
    data = vf.composition.empty,
    aes(x = lifestyle, y = 0.5, label = "No VF-positive\ngenomes"),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ category, switch = "x", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = vf.category.colors, drop = FALSE,
                     labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, 28)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of qualifying VF ORFs", fill = "VF category",
       title = "VF-category composition among VF-positive genomes",
       subtitle = "VFDB set A; conservative trimming; All = Lytic + Temperate") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4, byrow = TRUE))
vf.composition.stem <- paste0("vf_category_composition_by_category_lifestyle",
                               vf.category.tag)
write.csv(vf.composition, file.path(checkv.figs.dir,
                                   paste0(vf.composition.stem, ".csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(vf.composition.stem, ".svg")),
       plot = vf.composition.plot, width = 12, height = 8)
print(vf.composition.plot)
```


### Mapped-only VF-category composition and full-pool counts

Mapped VF ORFs have a nonblank category in `VFs.csv`. These additional bars
exclude unmapped calls from both numerator and denominator. All pools Lytic
and Temperate genomes; unknown lifestyles are excluded from plotted bars.
Bars with no mapped VF ORFs are explicitly marked.

The two count summaries retain every reference category and zero-count group.
**Full pool** includes every conservative-trimmed genome, including unknown
lifestyles. **All**, **Lytic**, and **Temperate** use the plotted population;
**Unknown** reports the excluded genomes and ORFs. These strata overlap:
Full pool = All + Unknown, and All = Lytic + Temperate. Columns distinguish
ORF counts from genome counts, including genomes with no qualifying VF calls.

```{r mapped-VF-composition-and-counts, results='asis', fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
vf.mapped.composition <- prepare.checkv.vf.composition(
  vf.plot.data, vf.category.features,
  category.names = names(vf.category.colors), mapped.only = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(vf.category = factor(vf.category, levels = names(vf.category.colors)),
         checkv.filter = conservative.filter, vfdb_version = bundle$tag,
         orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds", vf.reference = "VFs.csv")
vf.mapped.empty <- vf.mapped.composition %>%
  distinct(category, lifestyle, total.vf.orfs) %>% filter(total.vf.orfs == 0L)
vf.mapped.sums <- vf.mapped.composition %>%
  group_by(category, lifestyle) %>%
  summarise(total = first(total.vf.orfs), proportion = sum(proportion),
            .groups = "drop")
if (any(abs(vf.mapped.sums$proportion[vf.mapped.sums$total > 0] - 1) > 1e-10)) {
  stop("Mapped-only VF proportions do not sum to one")
}
vf.mapped.plot <- ggplot(
  vf.mapped.composition, aes(x = lifestyle, y = proportion, fill = vf.category)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(data = vf.mapped.empty,
            aes(x = lifestyle, y = 0.5, label = "No mapped\nVF ORFs"),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2) +
  facet_grid(~ category, switch = "x", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = vf.category.colors,
    breaks = setdiff(names(vf.category.colors), "Unmapped VF category"),
    drop = FALSE, labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, 28)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of mapped qualifying VF ORFs",
       fill = "VF category", title = "Mapped-only VF-category composition",
       subtitle = "VFDB set A; conservative trimming; All = Lytic + Temperate") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4, byrow = TRUE))
vf.mapped.stem <- paste0("vf_mapped_category_composition_by_category_lifestyle",
                          vf.category.tag)
write.csv(vf.mapped.composition,
          file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(vf.mapped.stem, ".csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(vf.mapped.stem, ".svg")),
       plot = vf.mapped.plot, width = 12, height = 8)
print(vf.mapped.plot)

vf.summaries <- prepare.checkv.vf.summaries(
  vf.plot.data, vf.category.features, names(vf.category.colors)
)
for (summary.name in names(vf.summaries)) {
  summary.table <- vf.summaries[[summary.name]] %>%
    mutate(checkv.filter = conservative.filter, vfdb_version = bundle$tag,
           orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds", vf.reference = "VFs.csv")
  write.csv(summary.table, file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(
    "vf_", gsub("\\.", "_", summary.name), vf.category.tag, ".csv"
  )), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n\n", if (summary.name == "category.counts") {
    "VF-category ORF counts"
  } else "Genome and VF ORF totals", "\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(summary.table))
}
```


### Balanced genome downsampling

Each of 1,000 iterations independently selects 30 lytic and 5 temperate
modern genomes per group without replacement, including zero-hit genomes.
All 30 paleo lytic and 5 paleo temperate genomes remain fixed. The same
selections feed both mapping versions. All pools the 35 genomes before
calculating proportions. Empty denominators yield zeros in every category,
including in means and 2.5th–97.5th percentiles; mean stacks may therefore
total less than one. Paleo bars are fixed observations without intervals.

```{r downsample-checkv-categories, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
vf.downsampling <- downsample.checkv.vf(
  vf.plot.data, vf.category.features, names(vf.category.colors)
)
export.vf.category.tables(
  vf.downsampling, checkv.figs.dir,
  "checkv_vf_category_downsampling_VFDB_setA_conservative"
)
for (mapping in c("mapped_inclusive", "mapped_only")) {
  for (layout in c("stacked", "grouped")) {
    plot <- create.vf.downsampling(
      vf.downsampling$summary, vf.category.colors, mapping, layout
    )
    stem <- paste("checkv_vf_category_downsampling", layout, mapping,
                   "VFDB_setA_conservative", sep = "_")
    ggsave(file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(stem, ".svg")), plot,
           width = 14, height = 10)
    print(plot)
  }
}
```

### Biological-sample VF-category differential representation

Mapped category counts are pooled across all conservative genomes within
each biological sample, independent of lifestyle. `pal.ENG_LG4560.69` and
`pal.AUT_2612` are excluded; there is no minimum-ORF cutoff. Samples with no
mapped VF ORFs are exported as omissions from testing. Unmapped counts are
exported separately and excluded before `log10(CPM + 1)` normalization.

Category-wise Kruskal–Wallis tests receive BH correction. A raw p-value below
0.05 triggers Dunn tests, with BH correction within category followed by BH
correction across categories per contrast. The exports distinguish raw
p-values, within-category q-values, and across-category q-values, and mark
undefined tests with `NA`. Replicates are biological samples, never draws.

```{r sample-category-differential, results='asis'}
vf.sample.keys <- vf.plot.data %>% transmute(
  checkv.filter, genome.id, category,
  sample.id = paste0(category, ".", origin, "_", sample)
)
vf.sample.category.counts <- vf.category.features %>%
  inner_join(vf.sample.keys, by = c("checkv.filter", "genome.id")) %>%
  count(sample.id, vf.category, name = "n")
vf.sample.category.results <- compare.sample.vf.categories(
  vf.sample.keys %>% distinct(sample.id, category),
  vf.sample.category.counts, names(vf.category.colors)
)
export.vf.category.tables(
  vf.sample.category.results, checkv.figs.dir,
  "checkv_sample_vf_category_differential_VFDB_setA_conservative"
)
print(knitr::kable(vf.sample.category.results$tests))
```

### Annotated maps of the top VF-bearing genomes

These maps rank the full conservative-trimmed genome pool by qualifying
VF-bearing ORF count, with genome ID breaking ties. Three genomes per category
are retained in `pal`, `pre`, `ind` order. Sample-prevalence exclusions and
minimum-denominator filters do not apply to this selection.

The supplemental `checkv_viral_cds_conservative.csv`, produced by stage 4a
from the existing viral Prokka GFF, contains **all** viral CDS, including
hypothetical proteins and proteins without EC numbers. VF calls come from the
separate bacterial-mode Prokka annotation and validated full-pool VFDB set A
search. Overlapping calls from these two prediction runs remain separate
features; matching feature IDs across runs does not imply matching ORFs.
`gene_features_selected9.tsv` adds CheckV HMM-hit ORFs at their supplied
coordinates when its genome IDs match the selected nine genomes. If they do
not match, the CheckV track is omitted and only viral and VF genes are shown.
Every nonblank, nonmissing `hmm_db` is included without an extra
score or E-value threshold; literal `NA` is treated as missing. CheckV hits
are purple, labeled with wrapped `desc` from `checkv_hmms.tsv`, followed by
`viral` or `microbial` on the next line. Missing descriptions use the HMM name
and `(no descriptive label)`, followed by the category. Lookup keys are
`hmm_db` to `database` and `hmm_name` to `hmm`; conflicting keys are an error.
The three tracks run from CheckV to viral EC-bearing ORFs to VF calls,
top to bottom, with separate label bands.

Arrows retain original base-pair coordinates and point according to strand.
Each panel has its own scale covering position 1 through the full genome
length. Only viral CDS with nonblank EC annotations are drawn, in blue with
labels showing annotation ID, protein product, and EC number. Every qualifying
VF call is drawn regardless of EC,
colored red, including unmapped calls, and labeled with
annotation ID, `VF_Name`, and category on successive lines. Labels include
features too narrow to contain text.
Complete tables retain undrawn viral CDS and mark each row's plotted-feature
status. Annotation IDs use category and selected-genome rank, followed by `V`
(viral), `C` (CheckV), or `F` (VF) and a coordinate-ordered index. They are
deterministic for
the selected genomes and retained in the annotation tables. Purple labels omit
annotation IDs; the tables retain HMM descriptions and categories.
Products and original VF descriptions are reproduced without inferring a
function for hypothetical proteins.

```{r top-VF-genome-maps, results='asis', fig.width=20, fig.height=90}
# read the complete viral-CDS supplement; existing filtered exports stay intact.
viral.cds.path <- file.path(data.dir, "checkv_viral_cds_conservative.csv")
if (!file.exists(viral.cds.path)) {
  stop(
    "Missing checkv_viral_cds_conservative.csv: rerun stage 4a and copy ",
    "the supplemental CSV from the cluster data directory into data_dir."
  )
}
viral.cds <- read.csv(
  viral.cds.path, check.names = FALSE,
  colClasses = c(checkv_filter = "character", genome_id = "character",
                feature_id = "character", strand = "character",
                product = "character", ec_number = "character")
) %>%
  rename(checkv.filter = checkv_filter, genome.id = genome_id,
         ec.number = ec_number)
checkv.gene.features <- read.delim(
  file.path(data.dir, "gene_features_selected9.tsv"), check.names = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("NA", ""), colClasses = c(contig_id = "character")
)
# select genomes before checking whether the optional CheckV track matches.
vf.genome.maps <- prepare.checkv.genome.maps(
  vf.plot.data, checkv.metadata, checkv.features, viral.cds, vf.reference
)
if (setequal(checkv.gene.features$contig_id,
             vf.genome.maps$selection$genome.id)) {
  checkv.hmms <- read.delim(
    file.path(data.dir, "checkv_hmms.tsv"), check.names = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("NA", ""), colClasses = "character"
  )
  vf.genome.maps <- prepare.checkv.genome.maps(
    vf.plot.data, checkv.metadata, checkv.features, viral.cds, vf.reference,
    selection = vf.genome.maps$selection,
    checkv.features = checkv.gene.features, checkv.hmms = checkv.hmms
  )
} else {
  cat("\n\nCheckV annotation genomes do not match the selected genomes. ",
      "Omitting the CheckV track; showing viral and VF genes only.\n\n",
      sep = "")
}
cat("\n\nPlotted CheckV HMM-hit ORFs: ",
    sum(vf.genome.maps$annotations$source.annotation.mode == "checkv"),
    " across ", nrow(vf.genome.maps$selection), " selected genomes.\n\n", sep = "")
vf.top.genome.selection <- vf.genome.maps$selection
vf.top.genome.annotations <- vf.genome.maps$annotations
vf.top.genome.separate <- create.checkv.genome.map(
  vf.genome.maps, "separate_tracks"
)

# export the three-track map, selection, and complete annotation table
vf.map.tag <- paste0("_", bundle$tag, "_", conservative.filter)
write.csv(
  vf.top.genome.selection,
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_top_genome_selection",
                                  vf.map.tag, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE, na = ""
)
write.csv(
  vf.top.genome.annotations,
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_top_genome_annotations",
                                  vf.map.tag, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE, na = ""
)
ggsave(
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_top_genome_maps_separate_tracks",
                                  vf.map.tag, ".svg")),
  plot = vf.top.genome.separate, width = 20, height = 90, limitsize = FALSE
)
print(knitr::kable(vf.top.genome.selection, row.names = FALSE))
cat("\n\n")
print(vf.top.genome.separate)

# print every plotted feature, keeping each genome's table together.
for (genome in vf.top.genome.selection$genome.id) {
  cat("\n\n#### ", genome, "\n\n", sep = "")
  # keep large annotation tables as raw HTML during Pandoc conversion.
  cat('\n\n```{=html}\n<div style="overflow-x: auto;">\n')
  print(knitr::kable(
    vf.top.genome.annotations %>% filter(genome.id == genome),
    row.names = FALSE, format = "html", escape = TRUE
  ))
  cat("\n</div>\n```\n\n")
}
```
